purpose: Remove naked caller freshness-floor facts from the shadow routing path by requiring a provider-authenticated RuntimeClockCheckpoint plus a chained authenticated RuntimeClockReceipt and exact signed W07 observation.
requirements: Routing-authoritative shadow projection must use project_secretary_with_authenticated_checkpoint_shadow; the v01 raw minimum_clock_seq/expected_previous_clock_hash interface is observational/compatibility-only and must not be adopted as an authority boundary.
RuntimeClockCheckpoint authenticates last_clock_seq, last_clock_hash, mission/step, installation/runtime and provider/key identity.
A caller cannot lower last_clock_seq or replace last_clock_hash without invalidating checkpoint authentication.
RuntimeClockReceipt must chain from checkpoint.last_clock_hash and have clock_seq strictly greater than checkpoint.last_clock_seq.
Checkpoint advancement stores the exact verified runtime clock receipt hash and never advances from an unauthenticated receipt.
W07 observation signature must bind the canonical SecretarySignalEnvelope fingerprint and its exact validity interval.
Authority conflict, stale/future envelope or no fresh fields always produce zero routing effect.
Per-field freshness remains independently bounded by the authenticated clock coordinate.
Clock/secretary/checkpoint maintenance creates zero Experience, zero operational progress and zero formal mutation authority.
self_review_fix: Initial v01 still accepted caller-provided minimum_clock_seq and expected_previous_clock_hash. V02 removes those naked facts from the routing-authoritative API and derives both only from an authenticated checkpoint.

trust_boundary.note: Signed checkpoints prevent unauthenticated floor downgrade but cannot prove rollback resistance if checkpoint storage and synthetic provider key are rolled back together. Production adoption requires an independently durable monotonic provider/floor outside the consumer rollback domain.

remaining_release_blockers: Real external runtime clock provider and independently rollback-resistant checkpoint/floor remain TEST_REQUIRED.
Production W07 signing key protection, rotation, revocation and signer attestation remain TEST_REQUIRED.
AuthorityDecisionEnvelope and AcceptedExperienceReceipt production signer authenticity remain unresolved.
Authenticated terminal-exit envelope and shared authoritative event classifier remain unresolved.
Fresh W03 behavior/personality review, current W04 synthesis, executable CI evidence and paired speed evidence remain required.
